profile.headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer @ Google | PhD in Computational Linguistics with a passion for AI, Catching replicants on the internet <bladerunner-emoji>
profile.summary: I am a  computational linguist and data scientist with a passion for building artificial intelligence and natural language processing systems.  I am eager to put my research capabilities to use in the software industry as I think we are approaching great advances in these fields. I also have experience in translation and extensive experience in teaching at the college level. I want to explore how the sister fields of NLP and Theoretical linguistics can inform each other to boost both the performance of our systems and our comprehension of human language.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Tech Lead for the reCaptcha evaluation team
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Security · Engineering Management · Unsupervised Learning · Monitoring

positions.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Part of a dedicated AI and ML pod delivering artificial intelligence solutions across all verticals. 
• Produced POC for automating QA processes of patient assessment forms that achieved over 70% automation while meeting SLA requirement of >95% accuracy. Used a combination of LLM fine tuning with heuristics. Unlocked the development of a human in the loop automation solution that will be responsible for more than half a million dollars in savings every year. 
• Refined and implemented ML ops procedures and architectures to facilitate fine tuning, deployment and evaluation of both LLM based and conventional machine learning models.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Large Language Models (LLM) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Sagemaker · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a new data architecture and warehouse infrastructure to streamline data access from third-party integrations, reducing report development time from 1-2 months to 2-5 days.
• Led a team of data engineers in developing and maintaining a portfolio of third-party API integrations, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and NLP models at Datapeople.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and developed scalable solutions for data ingestion, transformation, and serving, enabling science and linguistics teams to make data-driven decisions.
• Built a monitoring and alerting system to ensure smooth runs, SLA compliance, and SOC 2 certification, saving thousands in server costs.
• Maintained seven data integrations with third-party APIs and oversaw development of two new ones

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Git · Amazon S3 · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · SQL · Algorithms · Data Storage · Software Development

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
Altana Trade is an artificial intelligence partnership unlocking the power of global economic data to make trade safer, more efficient, and more profitable.
- Build deep learning models to detect anomalous or misdeclared data in trade records based on signal from both structured and unstructured fields.
- Design, build and test Machine Learning and NLP tools to link data and build knowledge representations based on trade and corporate ownership information from different sources.
- Engage deeply with in-domain experts to drive development of artificial intelligence tools to help analyze data on global trade networks.
positions.insights: Skills: Deep Learning · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Long Short-term Memory (LSTM) · Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) · Data Science · Data Warehousing · SQL · Algorithms · Software Development · Neural Language Models

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Explored and tested new strategies for semantic recovery in dialogue systems for Google Assistant.
- Built a system for automatic corpus collection from crowdsourcing platforms that handles conversation flow, including: automatic endpointing of live speech, interfacing with the Google Cloud Speech API, dialogue flow management and successive query narrowing by using the google Knowledge Graph.
- Set up and led studies to test system on a crowdsourcing platform.

positions.title: Research Assistant and Digital Fellow
positions.description:
- Develop Python scripts to handle the data pipeline and analysis (through topic modeling and machine learning) in a digital humanities project in partnership with Dr Lisa Rhody. Explain and interpret the models in terms accessible to a wider community within the humanities.
- Part of a think tank that promotes the use of digital research tools across all areas and provides researchers with support on topics ranging from research methodologies to the usage of specific technical tools and libraries.

company.name: The Graduate Center, City University of New York

positions.title: Graduate Center Fellow
positions.description:
- Led and designed graduate level coding labs and practicum sessions for classes on beginer and advanced computational linguistics, semantics and syntax.
- Created and taught undergraduate level courses in linguistics including semantics, historical linguistics and syntax, receiving the highest evaluation marks of "excellent" from observing faculty and students in every course.

positions.title: Translator and Interpreter
positions.description:
Translator From Spanish to English, English to Spanish, Spanish to French and French to Spanish of academic and legal texts.
Conference Simultaneous interpreter and Consecutive interpreter.
Worked for
Universidad de los Andes
Universidad Nacional de Colombia
Universidad Cooperativa de Colombia
